messages:
mia_fin: Orion Retail flagged ~3.5k missing embed units on their November statement (INV-ORION-20271101). They expect us to reconcile before statement is final.

ryan_sre: thanks, pinging ingest. any recent changes to stream heartbeats or partition offsets?

tom_ingest: we rolled a heartbeat optimization on 2027-11-18 to reduce emitter load. I see a small window where long-lived streaming sessions had their heartbeat offset advanced and the emitter skipped re-processing resumed chunks. Example log: 
```
2027-11-18T12:03:42Z node=ingest-12 session=orion-9 offset_jump=true skipped_emit=true
```

tom_ingest: quick query to estimate affected units: 
```
SELECT count(*) as skipped_events FROM stream_logs WHERE customer_id='orion_retail' AND timestamp >= '2027-11-18T12:00' AND timestamp < '2027-11-18T12:20' AND skipped_emit=true;
```

tom_ingest: result: skipped_events = 3,512. tokens_per_event ~1 => ~3,512 embed_units.

mia_fin: invoices already sent; finance needs confirm and proposed remediation.

ella_support: INV-ORION-20271101 sent yesterday. customer already opened a ticket asking why counts differ. They want a timeline.

ryan_sre: propose backfill BF-4120: replay raw stream chunks for the window and emit missing meter events. Low risk; we'll validate checksums. ETA 1.5 hours.

metering-bot: Alert: emitter-skip-rate anomaly detected on ingest-12 between 2027-11-18T12:00 and 2027-11-18T12:20. skipped=3512.

mia_fin: recommend provisional credit up to $400 while backfill runs (rate $0.10 per 1k tokens => $0.3512 ~ $0.35; use embedding pricing rounding). Approve?

ryan_sre: approve provisional credit up to $500. Backfill BF-4120 started at 2027-11-18T13:05Z.

tom_ingest: BF-4120 progress: 60% (2,100 events emitted). No checksum mismatches.

metering-bot: Backfill BF-4120: success at 2027-11-18T14:12Z. emitted=3512 reconciliation_id=ORION-RECON-20271118.

mia_fin: backfill succeeded. void provisional credit and attach ORION-RECON-20271118 to INV-ORION-20271101. Opening FIN-1175 to track follow-ups.

ella_support: customer updated and replied :thanks: — they asked what prevents recurrence.

ryan_sre: action items: 1) revert heartbeat optimization until we add an emit safety check; 2) add unit test for offset jumps; 3) dashboard alert for skipped_emit > 0.1% per node. I'll open PRs and link BF-4120.

mia_fin: closing FIN-1175 after invoice notes updated. Thanks everyone.
